title: Haddock and sweetcorn chowder
summary: Haddock and sweetcorn chowder is a british dinner built around haddock fillets and canned sweetcorn, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Haddock and sweetcorn chowder. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add haddock fillets and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and canned sweetcorn.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until new potatoes is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Haddock and sweetcorn chowder before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Haddock and sweetcorn chowder.  Check that the potatoes is tender, then serve.
